name: Idol/TYPE
source:
In Idol/TYPE you and your idol, the lesser-known supporting actress Hirae Erishima write letters to each other. At first they were just fan letters. But now, is there something more?

[From [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]Official site[/url]]
translation:
在《偶像/TYPE》中，你与偶像、名不见经传的配角演员平江绘梨岛互相写信。起初，那只是粉丝来信。但现在，是否还有更进一步的关系？

[来源：[url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]官方网站[/url]]
